name: @etzhayyim/resource-provider-kotoba
description: kotoba impl of resource-provider (Consensys c-split). Public marketplace catalog (resourceListing) + aggregate stats (contributionStat) plaintext; provider PII (providerProfile), contribution content (contributionEntry), reward ledger + balances (rewardLedgerEntry/rewardBalance) sealed via kotoba E2E (sdk.encryptedWrite/Read, ADR-2605181100). GPU/LLM inference, quality-validation compute, raw-credential custody, and the fiat MoR / payout settlement rail stay etzhayyim via consent-capability.
